3.name: Beguiling Magic
3.notes:
You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared.

After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can force a creature within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC. On a failure, it becomes Charmed or Frightened (your choice) for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

After using this benefit once, it can’t be used again until after a Long Rest unless you expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to restore it (no action required).

3.name: Mantle of Inspiration
3.notes: As a Bonus Action, expend a Bardic Inspiration use and roll the die. Choose creatures within 60 feet equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Each gains Temporary Hit Points equal to **2 × the number rolled**, and then each can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Mantle of Majesty
6.notes:
You always have Command prepared.

As a Bonus Action, you cast Command without a spell slot and take on a magical appearance for 1 minute (Concentration required). During this time, you may cast Command as a Bonus Action without spending a spell slot.

Creatures Charmed by you automatically fail saving throws against Command cast with this feature.

Once used, it can't be used again until a Long Rest unless you expend a 3rd-level or higher spell slot to restore it (no action required).

14.name: Unbreakable Majesty
14.notes:
As a Bonus Action, you take on a majestic presence for 1 minute or until Incapacitated. For the duration, whenever a creature hits you with an attack for the first time on a turn, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack misses as the attacker recoils.

Once used, you cannot use it again until completing a Short or Long Rest.
